translate_en|mods/SMB_AutoHIDEhud/42/med: While aiming, hides every SMB AutoHIDEhud group, even when its individual animation is disabled. Releasing aim restores each group to its normal Vanilla setting.
Hides the bottom hotbar and reveals it only from the area occupied by the panel. OFF restores vanilla behavior.
Tracks the real B42 building window and fades it smoothly in place when the cursor enters or leaves its actual area. Aiming keeps it hidden. OFF restores vanilla behavior immediately.
Fades the character information window, including Skills, Health and Protection, in place when the cursor leaves its area. OFF restores vanilla behavior.
Moves the clock and available time controls together and brings the stack in from the right edge. OFF restores vanilla behavior.
Tracks the real B42 crafting window and fades it smoothly in place when the cursor enters or leaves its actual area. Aiming keeps it hidden. OFF restores vanilla behavior immediately.
Assign a key to hide or show the mouse cursor during gameplay.
When the item in either hand changes, the bottom hotbar comes into view and hides again after the panel delay. Requires Animate bottom bar.
Show the hotbar when switching items
Controls how long normal panels wait after the cursor leaves before retracting. Higher values keep them visible longer and apply immediately. The minimap keeps its separate 3.5-second delay.

At each full in-game hour, reveals only the auto-hidden clock once and returns it smoothly while time controls stay hidden. A quiet sound plays only on this client and cannot be heard by zombies, the server or other players.
When the inventory or the container comes into view, the other one comes with it, so you can move items without either one hiding. Requires Animate inventories and containers.

Follows the actual position of the player inventory and containers, including panels moved by the player. A single click on another container changes the displayed loot without closing the panels; double-click outside them to close unpinned inventories. OFF restores vanilla behavior.
While the left sidebar is hidden, both hand slots stay in place and show what you are holding. Also applies while aiming with Hide all HUD while aiming. The rest of the sidebar stays hidden.

Hides the left sidebar and reveals it only when the cursor enters the panel's real area. While hidden, the vanilla health heart remains visible only during its damage animation. OFF restores vanilla behavior.
Assign a key to enable or disable automatic nearby-container reveal during gameplay.
Reveals the world inventory when the selected nearby container changes. Disable it to keep the panel hidden until you interact with it.
With Animate minimap with fade enabled, the open minimap stays visible while you are in a vehicle and fades again after you leave it. Aiming with Hide all HUD while aiming still hides it.
Fades the open minimap smoothly in its own current area and waits 3.5 seconds after the cursor leaves before fading out. OFF restores vanilla behavior.
When a new Moodle appears, brings the right-side group into view with three Morse-like pulses over about five seconds, without changing its color.

Extends the in-place fade to any other window open on screen, including windows from other mods. It appears when the cursor enters its area and fades after the panel delay. Confirmations, right-click menus, tooltips, text boxes in use and anything being dragged are left alone.
While the game is paused or the Esc menu is open, every hidden panel comes back into view. When the game resumes, each one hides again on its normal timing.
Moves active Moodles out through the right edge and reveals them from their real occupied area. OFF restores vanilla behavior.
Tracks the real Investigate Area window and fades it smoothly in place when the cursor enters or leaves its actual area. Aiming keeps it hidden. OFF restores vanilla behavior immediately.
Shows the vanilla version, coordinates, resolution and performance information in the bottom-right corner.
Includes the vehicle dashboard in the bottom-bar animation. This setting only applies while the bottom bar animation is enabled.
